description: Defines the CKEDITOR.tools object containing various utility functions for array comparison, object cloning, string manipulation, DOM style conversion, HTML encoding, function management, and class creation.

methods.name: arrayCompare
methods.description: Compares two arrays for equality of length and elements.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of an object, without support for recursive references.

methods.name: capitalize
methods.description: Converts the first letter of a string to uppercase.

methods.name: extend
methods.description: Copies properties from source objects to a target object, with optional overwrite and property list control.

methods.name: prototypedCopy
methods.description: Creates an object inheriting from a source object.

methods.name: isArray
methods.description: Checks if an object is an Array.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if an object has no own properties.

methods.name: cssStyleToDomStyle
methods.description: Transforms CSS property names to DOM style property names.

methods.name: buildStyleHtml
methods.description: Builds HTML for style/link tags from CSS strings or URLs.

methods.name: htmlEncode
methods.description: Encodes special HTML characters in a string.

methods.name: htmlEncodeAttr
methods.description: Encodes special HTML characters in an attribute value.

methods.name: getNextNumber
methods.description: Returns a unique incremental number for the session.

methods.name: getNextId
methods.description: Returns a unique ID string with 'cke_' prefix.

methods.name: override
methods.description: Creates a function override.

methods.name: setTimeout
methods.description: Executes a function after a delay, with scope and arguments.

methods.name: trim
methods.description: Removes boundary spaces from a string.

methods.name: ltrim
methods.description: Removes leading spaces from a string.

methods.name: rtrim
methods.description: Removes trailing spaces from a string.

methods.name: indexOf
methods.description: Finds the index of an element in an array.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Creates a function bound to a specific object context.

methods.name: createClass
methods.description: Creates a class with inheritance, static, private, and public fields.

methods.name: addFunction
methods.description: Creates a reference to a function for later invocation.

methods.name: removeFunction
methods.description: Removes a function reference created with addFunction.

methods.name: callFunction
methods.description: Calls a function by its reference.

methods.name: cssLength
methods.description: Appends 'px' to a length if missing.

methods.name: repeat
methods.description: Repeats a string a specified number of times.

methods.name: tryThese
methods.description: Executes multiple functions until one succeeds without exception.

methods.name: genKey
methods.description: Generates a combined key string from multiple parameters.
